inventory.caption: *Obligations and permitted realizations.* The obligations jointly admit an acceptable region; the controls jointly permit another. Where permitted exceeds acceptable, unacceptable realizations slip through — underconstraint; where acceptable exceeds permitted, acceptable alternatives are excluded — overconstraint.
inventory.conversion: TikZ diagram; inspect SVG and chapter/receipt
inventory.svg_title: Obligations and permitted realizations — underconstraint and overconstraint as the two mismatches
inventory.svg_description: Two overlapping outlined sets within the software realization space. A, acceptable realizations, has a solid outline. P, realizations permitted by controls, has a dashed outline. The acceptable-only region is overconstraint: acceptable alternatives excluded. The overlap is preserved freedom: acceptable and permitted. The permitted-only region is underconstraint: unacceptable yet permitted, a correctness risk.
